description:
Scholarship overview

The KAUST fellowship is linked to admission to an eligible graduate programme. PhD applicants seek a research place in science or engineering and receive support under the university's fellowship terms. The stipend range depends on qualifications and progression.

Research Areas

  • Science
  • Engineering
  • Doctoral research

Funding and duration

ComponentDetails
Award or positionPhD scholarship / studentship
Stipend / salaryUSD 20,000–30,000/year, depending on qualifications and progression

Eligibility and Requirements

CriterionRequirement
Applicant eligibilityWorldwide, subject to programme rules
Further conditionsAdmission-linked fellowship; tuition, living support and insurance; check programme requirements.

Application dates

ComponentDetails
Recruitment statusOpen
Deadline / consideration round3 January 2027 (round 2)
LocationSaudi Arabia

How to Apply

  1. Review the scholarship conditions alongside the doctoral programme’s admission requirements.
  2. Complete the admission, scholarship or nomination steps specified by the host; do not assume one submission covers every stage.
  3. Submit by the deadline for your applicant category, or follow the stated consideration round where applications are rolling.

About King Abdullah University of Science and Technology (KAUST)

KAUST is a graduate research university in Saudi Arabia. Eligible admitted PhD students receive fellowship support under university terms, with research organised through science and engineering programmes.

Official details: Read the programme or project information

Application route: Follow the official application instructions
